item.title: 2026 Winter Paralympics: 6 U.S. Women’s Sports Athletes to Watch in Milano-Cortina
item.description: Oksana Masters headlines the 20 US women competing at the 2026 Winter Paralympics, as the Team USA athlete hunts her 20th Paralympics medal. The post 2026 Winter Paralympics: 6 U.S. Women’s Sports Athletes to Watch in Milano-Cortina appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Naomi Osaka Downs Osorio at Indian Wells, Sets Up Sabalenka Showdown
item.description: Naomi Osaka avenged her 2025 Indian Wells first-round loss to Camila Osorio with a three-set win, advancing to face No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka. The post Naomi Osaka Downs Osorio at Indian Wells, Sets Up Sabalenka Showdown appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Ohio State Women’s Hockey Earns No. 1 Seed in 2026 NCAA Tournament
item.description: Ohio State women's hockey earned the No. 1 overall seed in the 2026 NCAA tournament, while preparing to host this week's Columbus Regional. The post Ohio State Women’s Hockey Earns No. 1 Seed in 2026 NCAA Tournament appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Coco Gauff Exits 2026 Indian Wells Match with Injury as Alexandra Eala Advances
item.description: Coco Gauff left her Indian Wells match against Alex Eala with a left arm injury, after the world No. 4 trailed the rising star 6-2, 0-2. The post Coco Gauff Exits 2026 Indian Wells Match with Injury as Alexandra Eala Advances appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: UConn Women’s Basketball Routs Creighton to Book Big East Tournament Final
item.description: UConn women's basketball dominated Creighton 100-51 in Sunday's Big East semifinal, booking the program's 22nd conference tournament final. The post UConn Women’s Basketball Routs Creighton to Book Big East Tournament Final appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USWNT Tops Colombia 1-0 to Win 2026 SheBelieves Cup

item.title: Team USA’s Oksana Masters Wins 20th Paralympic Medal with Biathlon Gold
item.description: Four-sport US talent Oksana Masters earned a 20th Paralympic medal on Saturday, winning gold in the sprint sitting biathlon. The post Team USA’s Oksana Masters Wins 20th Paralympic Medal with Biathlon Gold appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
